This would be very useful to use in conjunction with the unofficial c# web export. Is there any horizon for it to be ready? 

Great job and thank you!
It's ready, but the PRs it depends on must be merged first.

In the process of testing this collection of PRs more in-depth, but I found a bug that crashes the editor
```cs
[Export] Array<Node> _array = [];
```
Put this into any script and it should immediately crash, and if it doesn't crash it'll display the same error. 

Tested internally with a custom build, but for the sake of an MRP I used the [uploaded artifact](https://productionresultssa8.blob.core.windows.net/actions-results/39f9bd0d-787d-47fc-86b6-ed724bdb0b67/workflow-job-run-cf7404b5-2144-56ec-a1b9-7ce31464e21f/artifacts/48affdd0c6ab30d97ef75baf5b859a0492166db5432fac84df4800ba698680b3.zip?rscd=attachment%3B+filename%3D%22linux-editor-mono.zip%22&rsct=application%2Fzip&se=2026-08-28T06%3A40%3A40Z&sig=7FmkD3A0cbfY1%2B5dw99fwz1gp9NfFKEofMU5qBnqdy4%3D&ske=2026-08-28T08%3A35%3A51Z&skoid=ca7593d4-ee42-46cd-af88-8b886a2f84eb&sks=b&skt=2026-08-28T04%3A35%3A51Z&sktid=398a6654-997b-47e9-b12b-9515b896b4de&skv=2025-11-05&sp=r&spr=https&sr=b&st=2026-08-28T06%3A30%3A35Z&sv=2025-11-05)

Or is it this supposed to be an internal thing that's leaking out? (To clarify I did rebuild the nuget packages with the new GodotSharp package built from source)

I tried that line in one of my projects and I got a different exception. It seems I forgot to implement the initialization logic for `NativeProxyRegistry` for use by the generic collections.
I didn't get the exceptions you mentioned. It might be a result of the same problem, or it might be a different one that I should look into. But your MRP link is down so I can't check.

The hyperlink went to an uploaded artifact of this PR which is now dead I guess, what I was meaning to say is that I used that artifact and then made a new project with a script that only contained that exported array. 
Very interesting that you got a different error, once you resolve the error you found I can give it another try and see if it fixes the one I found, I had to remove the PR from my custom build for the time being, but the 300 and 301 seem to be working quite well and I haven't found any instabilities or crashes with them.

I tested the unchanged attribute/generator code at c0b714b with isolated .NET 8/Roslyn repros. I understand that actual trimmed export is outside this PR’s scope. Could you check these three cases?

1. In GenericScriptTypeMetaProviderAttribute, GetNestedType on a closed generic type still returns an open nested provider, so the subsequent check throws even under ordinary JIT. This appears separate from the NativeProxyRegistry initialization issue discussed above.
2. RegisterScriptTypesGenerator does not filter NoScriptFileAssociation, so annotated types still receive path registration and ScriptPathAttribute, contrary to the opt-out described in the PR.
3. GetGodotClassScriptMetaGenerator.Model compares only the type name. Reusing a GeneratorDriver after changing a class’s base from Node to Resource still produces Node.CachedType; a fresh driver produces the correct result.

These repros use minimal stubs for surrounding Godot types/helpers and have not been validated in a full engine or export build.
